content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected for Nebula Bank (dedicated-eu-2) — spike in 5xx from model-routing layer, rolling counts > 10% p95 over last 2m. auto-page -> @oncall-pager :pager: 

devon: seeing it too, console shows routing errors hitting the dedicator proxy. 5xx are mostly `502`/`504` from downstream runtime pools.

maria: tagging CS so we can prepare customer comms: @cs-manager can you pull the contact list? want to confirm primary POC for Nebula Bank.

cs-manager: on it. getting Nebula contacts from enterprise CRM now. primary: Jane Doe (jane.doe@nebula.com, +44 7700 900111), secondary: Omar Ruiz (omar.ruiz@nebula.com). RU/EN support. Confirmed they have Dedicated EU region reservations.

sre-lead: quick triage notes: 1) routing layer saturating due to recent autoscaler regression, 2) fallback routes to smaller quantized model variant are healthy but not enabled for Nebula by policy, 3) KV cache layer showing increased miss ratio.

devon: attempting rolling restart of routing workers in eu-rt-02 to clear transient sockets. will throttle new connections for 60s.

oncall-pager: paging primary oncall (devon) and SRE lead. current severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting, single enterprise).

maria: drafting status-page & customer notification. initial status page blurb below — please validate: 

```
Status: Degraded Performance
Affected Service: Inference routing (Dedicated EU cluster: dedicated-eu-2)
Impact: Nebula Bank may experience increased request latency and elevated error rates (5xx). Some requests may fail intermittently.
Detected: 2026-03-15 09:20 UTC
Mitigation: Engineers are restarting routing workers and enabling fallback routing. A customer-specific fallback to quantized model variant is being considered.
Next Update: 20 minutes
```

sre-lead: fine to post that. change "fallback routing" to "partial fallback to compatible model variants" for accuracy. also add: "we do not anticipate data loss; requests may need retries."

maria: updated. preparing customer-facing email draft below — please keep concise and avoid internal jargon.

```
Subject: Nebula Bank — Temporary Inference Errors in EU Region (Dedicated)

Hi Jane,

We’re investigating an incident affecting Nebula Bank’s Dedicated EU cluster (dedicated-eu-2) that may cause intermittent 5xx errors and increased latency. Our engineers have started targeted mitigations (routing worker restarts and enabling partial fallback routing).

What we’re doing:
- Restarting routing workers to clear degraded connections.
- Enabling fallback routing to a compatible quantized model to reduce failures.
- Monitoring for successful recovery; will provide updates every 20 minutes.

Impact: Some inference requests may fail intermittently for up to X minutes while we finish mitigations. No customer data has been impacted.

If you need an urgent callback, please reply to this message or call +44 7700 900111.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

devon: small nit — remove "X minutes" and replace with ETA: ~15–30 minutes, but only if SRE lead agrees.

sre-lead: ETA 15–30m for routing restarts and validate fallback. agree to update email to say "expected recovery within 15–30 minutes".

maria: updated email accordingly. prepping to send once we confirm fallback enablement.

eng-ops: note on routing policy: Nebula has stricter routing policy (no auto-fallback) per contract. we need explicit approval or apply emergency override (changes will be logged). advise CS/AM we’re doing override now for mitigation.

cs-manager: noted — I will log a high-priority support case and flag AM. sending quick internal notification to Nebula POC right now (informational).

oncall-pager: log: PD incident 2456789 created, escalation path set to SRE Lead -> Eng Ops -> CTO on call.

devon: performed rolling restart on eu-rt-02 routing pool (commands run):
```
for node in eu-rt-02-0{1..4}; do ssh $node 'systemctl restart redwood-routing'; done
```
restarts succeeded with transient reconnects.

sre-lead: enabling emergency override to allow partial fallback for Nebula only. command: `redwood-policy apply --account NB-NEBULA --override fallback:enabled=true --expires 00:30`

eng-ops: confirm override applied and logged to audit (audit id: AUD-20260315-7832). fallback routing path activated to quantized-3b-compatible model variant.

devon: after override, error rate dropped from 12.7% -> 2.1% within 2m. latency p95 improved ~250ms.

maria: drafting quick status update for status page + customer: 

"Update 09:37 UTC: Routing worker restarts complete and emergency fallback enabled for Nebula Bank. Error rates have significantly reduced. Engineers continue to monitor and will provide a follow-up when fully resolved."

cs-manager: sending the customer email now (copied to this thread): 

```
Hi Jane,

Update: Our engineers have enabled a temporary routing fallback and completed targeted restarts. Error rates have dropped and we expect requests to be stable. Please let us know if you see any remaining failures; we are monitoring closely.

If you require a call, reply or call +44 7700 900111.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

maria: status page updated. public incident link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/nb-dedicated-eu-20260315 (internal only for now; will post public once we confirm full recovery).

sre-lead: next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) roll back emergency override if stable, 3) follow up with post-incident notes and root cause (likely autoscaler regression) and recommended config change for Nebula routing policy to allow conditional fallback.

devon: agreeds. setting a 30m watch timer. will capture logs and attach to PD ticket.

oncall-pager: timer set. last check-in will be at 09:50 UTC.

cs-manager: internal customer comms template for AMs (short): 

"Heads up AMs — Nebula Bank experienced intermittent dedicated-eu-2 errors starting 09:20 UTC. We applied an emergency override to enable fallback routing; systems are stable and error rates reduced. ETA for full validation 30m. Contact Jane Doe (jane.doe@nebula.com) for direct coordination."

eng-ops: also adding routing policy change RFC to backlog: `RFC-NEBULA-FALLBACK` — propose conditional fallback by default for dedicated accounts with critical SLAs.

maria: thanks everyone. final note: attach customer-specific impact summary for postmortem: 
- Accounts affected: NB-001 (prod), NB-002 (staging), NB-003 (analytics)
- POCs: Jane Doe, Omar Ruiz
- Start: 2026-03-15 09:20 UTC, Mitigated: 09:37 UTC (partial), Monitoring until 10:07 UTC
- Actions: routing restarts, emergency fallback, audit log AUD-20260315-7832

sre-lead: capturing that in PD ticket and will schedule follow-up with Nebula AMs later today.

devon: closing loop — error rate stable at 1.9% now, no further action required unless it spikes.

oncall-pager: incident marked as "Mitigated". leaving thread open until 10:07 UTC for confirmation. :white_check_mark:
